note: Every `overrides` entry in every workspace package.json is a deliberate deviation from a dependency's declared graph, taken to INSTALL a fixed package rather than to suppress or weaken `npm audit`. This register is the machine-readable binding: each record names the exact package, the declared spec, the resolved lockfile version, the dependency ancestry, whether the package is reachable from a production root, the advisories the override clears today, an owner, and a mandatory review deadline. scripts/validate-dependency-overrides.js fails CI when a live override is unregistered, a record is stale, a version drifts, a dev-only claim is contradicted by the locked graph, or a review deadline has passed. `advisory_basis` separates an override that clears a CURRENT advisory from one that has become redundant upstream (HISTORICAL) — a redundant override is a silent permanent fork, so it must carry a near-term review deadline and a removal check. Prose records live in docs/DEPENDENCY-OVERRIDES.md and are referenced by `record`.

overrides.reason: miniflare declares sharp 0.34.5 exact, and sharp < 0.35.0 carries high-severity inherited libvips advisories that fail the `npm audit --audit-level=high` CI gate. sharp is pulled only by the dev toolchain, is never imported by the Worker source, and its only miniflare entry point is the Cloudflare Images binding simulation, which this project does not register.
overrides.removal_criterion: Remove when a supported wrangler (and its bundled miniflare) declares sharp >= 0.35.0. Verify by deleting the entry, confirming `npm ls sharp` resolves >= 0.35.0 with no `overridden` marker, `npm audit --audit-level=high` stays at 0, and `npx wrangler deploy --dry-run` still builds.

overrides.production_reachability_reason: react-router-dom is a production dependency of the Pages application, so the overridden router ships in the customer bundle. The override exists to INSTALL the fixed router (8.3.0) rather than to accept the vulnerable one, so there is no closure-absence claim to make. The cleared advisory affects only the unstable RSC/server-action paths, which this client-rendered Vite SPA does not use.
overrides.reason: No single clean react-router-dom release clears the current advisory set: react-router-dom@8.3.0 does not exist, and the latest DOM compatibility package (7.18.1) declares react-router 7.18.1 exactly, which is inside the still-affected high-severity range >=7.12.0 <8.3.0.
overrides.removal_criterion: Remove when a supported react-router-dom declares a router version unaffected by all four advisories. Verify by deleting only this override, installing the supported DOM/router pair with no invalid or overridden dependency, keeping `npm audit --audit-level=high` at 0, and passing frontend typecheck, coverage tests and production build.

overrides.range_justification: Retained as the original range from the 2026-07-05 remediation. esbuild is a build-time-only tool with no shipped artefact, and the range floor (0.25.0) is itself the security boundary. The resolved version is pinned by the committed lockfile, so the installed graph cannot drift without a reviewed lockfile diff.
overrides.historical_note: Introduced 2026-07-05 (commit 2bdf413) alongside the Vite 6 upgrade to clear GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 (esbuild <= 0.24.2 lets any website send arbitrary requests to the local dev server and read the response). The override was undocumented until this register. It is now REDUNDANT: the pinned vite@6.4.3 itself declares `esbuild: ^0.25.0`, so the override forces exactly what vite already requires, and esbuild@0.25.12 carries no advisory. Retained only to avoid unrelated dependency movement in the PR that introduced this register; scheduled for removal at the review date.
overrides.reason: Historical remediation of GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99. No current advisory basis — see historical_note.
overrides.removal_criterion: Remove at or before the review date. Verify by deleting the entry, confirming `npm ls esbuild` still resolves >= 0.25.0 with no `overridden` marker, `npm audit --audit-level=high` stays at 0, and the production build passes. If all hold, delete this record.

overrides.historical_note: Introduced 2026-07-24 (commit 9b81819) to close a then-current brace-expansion denial-of-service advisory reached through @vitest/coverage-v8's declared test-exclude ^7.0.1 and its glob/minimatch chain; forcing 8.0.0 moved coverage onto the glob 13 / minimatch 10 chain. The override was undocumented until this register. It is now REDUNDANT on current registry facts: a fresh test-exclude@7.0.1 graph resolves brace-expansion 2.1.4 and audits clean, and test-exclude@8.0.0 itself carries no advisory. Retained only to avoid unrelated dependency movement in the PR that introduced this register; scheduled for removal at the review date.
overrides.reason: Historical remediation of a brace-expansion advisory reached through the coverage tool chain. No current advisory basis — see historical_note.
overrides.removal_criterion: Remove at or before the review date. Verify by deleting the entry, confirming `npm audit --audit-level=high` stays at 0 with the restored test-exclude 7 chain, and coverage tests still pass. If all hold, delete this record.

overrides.reason: miniflare declares undici 7.28.0 exact, and every 7.x below 7.29.0 carries five advisories, one of them high (GHSA-4cwx-7wf7-3272 — cross-user information disclosure and parse-time crash via degenerate private cache directives, CVSS 7.4). undici 7.29.0 is published and is the patched release for all five, but no miniflare release consumes it: the latest miniflare (4.20260730.0) still pins 7.28.0 exactly, and npm's own `fixAvailable` proposes wrangler 4.35.0, which is a DOWNGRADE from the pinned 4.110.0. The override installs the fixed undici rather than admitting the vulnerable one through an audit exception. undici is a dev-toolchain package only — the Worker runs on Cloudflare workerd and does not ship undici as its fetch implementation.
overrides.removal_criterion: Remove when a supported wrangler (and its bundled miniflare) declares undici >= 7.29.0. Verify by deleting the entry, confirming `npm ls undici` resolves >= 7.29.0 with no `overridden` marker, `npm audit --audit-level=high` stays at 0, and `npx wrangler deploy --dry-run` still builds.
